decisions.label: Area blend (m)
decisions.note: How far each area's trees, bushes and ground cover reach into its neighbours (Ed, 2026-10-26: "The effect that makes tree placement from neighbouring areas blend should be increased"): the neighbour's share ramps from about half at the border to none this many metres in, the band wandering by the tuning's areaEdgeBlend.warp. 40 was the old blend, 0 a hard edge. A new map: it reloads.
